dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct light-intensity O-shaped and C-shaped rings with sharp exterior perimeters and inward gradients. Notable structures include a large elliptical annulus in the mid-left and two smaller, tightly clustered circular annuli located inferiorly to the larger one.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the dorsal-most ridge and in the spaces between the larger ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the large mid-left annulus and the two smaller inferior annuli form a scalene triangle. An elongated, irregular chain of keypoints is formed by the centroids of the interconnected ring structures along the upper dorsal field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, localized series of 5-7 parallel, vertical high-intensity ridges on the mid-right lateral flank, resembling a rake-like or comb-like trauma mark.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific vertical-striated internal morphology of the large scar on the right flank is highly unique compared to the surrounding stochastic texture.
